newsitem.title: UK: Britain launches review of water charging system.
newsitem.headline: Britain launches review of water charging system.

text.p: Britain on Wednesday launched a review of the water charging system in England and Wales as proposed "...to ensure that it operates in a fair and equitable way," the Environment Ministry said.
Deputy Prime Minister John Prescott had already promised a review in May as part of a plan for a better water industry, the ministry added.
The review will include looking at the charges for both measured and unmeasured systems, the future use of rateable values in unmeasured systems and debt recovery arrangements, the ministry said.
The review follows increased concern over water consumption in Britain after prolonged drought periods and severely leaking water pipes.
